### Running time

```{r running-time, echo = FALSE, eval = TRUE}
end_time = Sys.time()
end_time - start_time
```

### Useful code

If you want to change a certain part of the code using the following code in Unix:

```{batch eval = FALSE}
#Rmd script
cd /Users/ema/Documents/GitHub/RelativeSize/2_r_files; sed -i '' 's/old_string/new_string/g' *.Rmd

#R script
cd /Users/ema/Documents/GitHub/RelativeSize/2_r_files/functions; sed -i '' 's/old_string/new_string/g' *.R
```

If you want to share a dataset and get a reproducible object, use the following R code:

```{batch eval = FALSE}
dput(data)
```

If you want to run a Tweedie distribution

```{batch eval = FALSE}
model <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(get(response_variable) ~
                            size * connection +
                            (1 | ecosystem_ID) +
                            (1 | day),
                          data = filtered_data,
                          family = tweedie)
```
